snippet.title: Archetype Blue - Official Trailer | Demo Out Now!
snippet.description:
Try Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2541560/ARCHETYPE_BLUE/

“Archetype Blue” is a pixel-art deckbuilding roguelite where you form an expedition party with over 50 unique allies, collect, use, and upgrade cards, and overcome battles through strategy.

Become a legendary hero and set out with your allies to explore various regions of a fantasy world.
Build your deck and expedition party with your own strategy, make choices, face unpredictable events, and lead your party safely to its destination.

Developer: Codename Bom
X: https://x.com/codenamebom
